docs/instructions.md:88:For version 1.1.7 and below, the `embed` tag had the `allowScriptAccess` parameter hard-coded to `always`. This allowed the "`ZeroClipboard.swf`" file to be hosted on an external domain. However, to enhance security, versions after 1.1.7 have an option for `allowScriptAccess` with a default of `sameDomain`, which only allows "`ZeroClipboard.swf`" to be served from the same domain as the hosting page.
